works.title: Booking Agent
works.alt: Booking Agent demo: chat on the left, the fields the rules found on the right

type.zh: 双语 LLM 预订助手 · 2026

pitch.en: Books only on an explicit yes. Rules, not the model, fill every booking field.
pitch.zh: 只有客人明确说“是”才下单；每个预订字段都由规则而不是模型填写。

spec.en: Sole engineer. Independent reimplementation of Nalu, the guest chat agent I rebuilt at IPOT
spec.zh: 独立完成。对我在 IPOT 重建的客人助手 Nalu 的独立重写

spec.en: Synthetic conversations, fixed clock
spec.zh: 合成对话，固定时钟

spec.en: Live demo · Nalu itself is in pre-launch testing
spec.zh: 在线演示 · Nalu 本身处于预发布测试

problem.en: An LLM-only pilot of Nalu got 17 of 30 messages fully right (57%) and invented booking values that guests never gave. A wrong party size or time is a real table problem on a Friday night.
problem.zh: Nalu 的纯 LLM 试点只有 17/30 条消息完全正确（57%），还会编造客人没给的预订值。人数或时间错了，周五晚上就是真实的桌位事故。

approach.en: Rules, not a model, read date, time, party size and name. Anything ambiguous (“at 7”) becomes a question.
approach.zh: 日期、时间、人数和姓名由规则读取，不交给模型；任何含糊处（“7 点”）都变成追问。

approach.en: One action, create_reservation, runs only after a bare, explicit yes. “ok” or “好” asks again. The result stays pending until the restaurant confirms.
approach.zh: 唯一的动作 create_reservation 只在明确的“是”之后执行；“ok”“好”会再问一次。结果在餐厅确认前保持 pending。

approach.en: With Ollama running locally, the page asks your own model to read the same conversation and marks where it guessed.
approach.zh: 本地运行 Ollama 时，页面会让你自己的模型读同一段对话，并标出它猜测的地方。

l.en: model-only pilot (30 cases) · rules + gate on a separate held-out set (39 cases); not a like-for-like before and after
l.zh: 纯模型试点（30 例）· 规则 + 确认闸门在另一份留出集上（39 例）；两者不是严格可比的前后对照

l.en: invented values on the held-out set
l.zh: 留出集上编造的值

l.en: synthetic conversations run as tests in the browser
l.zh: 在浏览器中作为测试运行的合成对话

l.en: live replay turns / failures on Nalu (23 conversations × 3 runs)
l.zh: Nalu 实时回放轮数 / 失败数（23 段对话 × 3 次）

limits.en: The 33/39 and replay numbers were measured on Nalu, not on this demo; the demo reproduces the design on synthetic data.
limits.zh: 33/39 和回放数据测自 Nalu，而不是本演示；演示用合成数据复现同一设计。

limits.en: The model comparison needs a local Ollama, so most visitors see only the rules path.
limits.zh: 模型对比需要本地 Ollama，大多数访客只能看到规则路径。

works.title: POS Platform
works.alt: POS platform demo: cashier terminal, kitchen display and guest phone

pitch.en: Run a shift and watch every tap become one transaction. Refunds wait for a manager.
pitch.zh: 跑一班营业，看每次点击变成一笔事务；退款要经理批准。

spec.en: Sole engineer of this demo. Modelled on the POS backend I led at IPOT (a team-built platform)
spec.zh: 本演示由我独立完成；原型是我在 IPOT 主导的 POS 后端（团队共建）

spec: JavaScript · in-page FastAPI-style services · WebSocket rooms

spec.en: Synthetic menu, tables and payments
spec.zh: 合成菜单、桌位与付款

spec.en: Live demo
spec.zh: 在线演示

problem.en: Settling a bill used to take four separate API calls. If the process died between them, a table could be marked paid with no payment row, or paid twice on retry.
problem.zh: 结账原本要四次独立 API 调用；进程在中间崩溃，就可能出现“已付款却没有付款记录”，或者重试时重复收款。

approach.en: POST /orders/{id}/settle does payment, tip, close and table release in one transaction. A side-by-side lets you kill the process at any step and compare.
approach.zh: POST /orders/{id}/settle 在一个事务里完成付款、小费、结单和清台；可以在任意一步“杀掉进程”对比新旧做法。

approach.en: Menu prices are snapshotted at sale time, so a price change never rewrites an open bill. Voids are logged; refunds over the limit wait for a manager.
approach.zh: 售出时快照菜品价格，改价不会改写未结账单；作废留痕；超额退款等经理批准。

approach.en: Nalu sits at the edge: bookings go to the Reservation API with an Idempotency-Key; a retry replays, a different payload gets 409.
approach.zh: Nalu 在边缘：预订带 Idempotency-Key 发往 Reservation API；重试会重放结果，不同请求体返回 409。

l.en: tests, run in the browser or in Node
l.zh: 个测试，可在浏览器或 Node 运行

l.en: refused requests in “Try to break it” / rows they write
l.zh: “试着弄坏它”中被拒绝的请求 / 写入行数

l.en: guided tour that plays a whole shift
l.zh: 播放整班营业的导览

limits.en: Uses IPOT's design tokens and wordmark; licensed typefaces are replaced with Google Fonts.
limits.zh: 使用 IPOT 的设计令牌与字标；授权字体以 Google Fonts 替代。

limits.en: Services run in the page, not against a real database; the transaction boundaries mirror the production design.
limits.zh: 服务在页面内运行而非真实数据库；事务边界与生产设计一致。

works.title: Refund Agent
works.alt: Refund Agent demo: proposed refund awaiting human approval

pitch.en: The model proposes, it cannot pay. Fixed checks, human approval, hash-chained ledger.
pitch.zh: 模型只能提议、不能付款：固定校验、人工批准、哈希链账本。

spec.en: Sole engineer
spec.zh: 独立完成

spec.en: Synthetic customers and payments
spec.zh: 合成客户与付款

spec.en: Live demo
spec.zh: 在线演示

problem.en: Letting an LLM handle refunds is useful until it refunds the whole charge for one cold dish, or tells the customer the money is on its way before anyone approved it.
problem.zh: 让 LLM 处理退款很有用，直到它为一道凉了的菜退掉整单，或者在没人批准前就告诉客户“钱已退”。

approach.en: Tools are split: find_my_payments and get_bill read; propose_refund only queues. Identity comes from the session, so the model cannot reach another customer.
approach.zh: 工具分权：find_my_payments、get_bill 只读；propose_refund 只入队。身份取自会话，模型碰不到其他客户。

approach.en: Every proposal passes fixed checks (owner, whole cents, still refundable, a reason). Over $50 needs a manager; review flags point at odd amounts.
approach.zh: 每个提议都过固定校验（归属、整分、可退余额、理由）。超过 $50 需经理；审核标记指出异常金额。

approach.en: A reply that claims the refund is done before approval is replaced with a fixed template.
approach.zh: 在批准前声称“已退款”的回复会被替换为固定模板。

l.en: tests, including a replay of every recorded run
l.zh: 个测试，含每段录制运行的回放

l.en: threshold above which a manager must approve
l.zh: 超过此金额必须经理批准

limits.en: Recordings come from one model (qwen2.5:7b); there is no over-refund rate across many runs yet.
limits.zh: 录制只来自一个模型（qwen2.5:7b）；尚无多次运行下的超额退款率。

works.title: PII Detector
works.alt: PII Detector demo: text with detected cards, emails and keys highlighted

pitch.en: Finds cards, emails, phones and API keys before text reaches a model.
pitch.zh: 在文本进入模型之前，找出卡号、邮箱、电话和 API 密钥。

spec.en: Sole engineer. The browser demo of the detector from my governance platform
spec.zh: 独立完成；是我治理平台中检测器的浏览器版演示

spec.en: 5,466 synthetic bilingual records
spec.zh: 5,466 条合成双语记录

spec.en: Live demo · detector service in a private repo
spec.zh: 在线演示 · 检测服务在私有仓库

problem.en: Employees paste customer data into AI tools. Masking has to happen before the text leaves the device, and it has to work for Chinese text as well as English.
problem.zh: 员工会把客户数据贴进 AI 工具。脱敏必须在文本离开设备之前完成，而且中文和英文都要能用。

approach.en: Rules first: card numbers must pass Luhn, so an order number is never called a card. Repeated values keep the same placeholder.
approach.zh: 规则优先：卡号必须通过 Luhn 校验，订单号不会被当成卡号；重复的值保持同一个占位符。

approach.en: An optional local model adds names, addresses and dates, running on WebGPU after a one-time download; the page counts network requests during detection.
approach.zh: 可选的本地模型补充姓名、地址和日期，一次下载后在 WebGPU 上运行；页面统计检测期间的网络请求数。

approach.en: Found that Presidio's \b patterns never match an ID written straight after Chinese text, and replaced them with boundary-safe patterns plus check digits.
approach.zh: 发现 Presidio 的 \b 模式匹配不到紧跟中文的证件号，改为边界安全的模式并加校验位。

l.en: Chinese national-ID recall after boundary-safe rules (cards 23% → 91%)
l.zh: 边界安全规则后的中文身份证召回率（卡号 23% → 91%）

l.en: p95 per record, rules + model, local NVIDIA GB10 (rules alone 0.5 ms)
l.zh: 每条记录 p95，规则 + 模型，本地 NVIDIA GB10（仅规则 0.5 ms）
浏览器内检测期间的网络请求
检测服务测试（pytest）

limits.en: Chinese person names reach 39% recall and addresses 67%; no openly licensed Chinese NER model had training data I could verify.
limits.zh: 中文人名召回 39%、地址 67%；没有找到训练数据可核实的开源中文 NER 模型。

limits.en: The corpus is synthetic, so the numbers compare configurations, not production accuracy. The model download is about 840 MB and needs Chrome or Edge.
limits.zh: 语料是合成的，数字用于比较配置而非生产准确率。模型约 840 MB，需要 Chrome 或 Edge。

cap.zh: 录屏 · 隐私模型在浏览器本地运行

works.alt: Career OPS dashboard: open roles with source filters

pitch.en: A traceable job-market feed from employer ATS APIs, plus résumé-aware interview practice, built on open-source career-ops.
pitch.zh: 基于雇主 ATS API 的可追溯岗位数据流，加上结合简历的面试练习，构建于开源 career-ops 之上。

spec.en: Built the market-feed pipeline, resume tooling and public release on top of open-source santifer/career-ops (MIT)
spec.zh: 在开源 santifer/career-ops（MIT）之上构建岗位数据管道、简历工具与公开发布

spec: Python · FastAPI · SQLite/FTS5 · Next.js · TypeScript · Azure VM · Caddy

spec.en: Public job postings from employers' own hiring systems
spec.zh: 来自雇主自有招聘系统的公开岗位

spec.en: Read-only public dashboard on my Azure VM
spec.zh: 部署在我自己 Azure 虚拟机上的只读公开看板

problem.en: A third-party job feed labelled rows as “recent”, but only 214 of 1,375 (16%) were actually posted in the last three days.
problem.zh: 第三方岗位源把数据标为“最近”，但 1,375 条里只有 214 条（16%）真的是近三天发布的。

approach.en: Collect straight from employers' ATS APIs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and more), keeping source URLs and which date field each timestamp came from.
approach.zh: 直接从雇主 ATS API（Greenhouse、Lever、Ashby 等）采集，保留来源链接和每个时间戳来自哪个日期字段。

approach.en: Never delete: a posting closes only after it is missing twice in a row, and every status change is kept.
approach.zh: 永不删除：连续两次缺失才关闭岗位，每次状态变化都保留。

approach.en: Before release, every public field passes known-field rules, the bilingual PII detector and a fail-closed scan.
approach.zh: 发布前，每个公开字段都要过已知字段规则、双语 PII 检测器和失败即拒绝的扫描。

approach.en: Résumé-aware interview practice that runs locally, with a check that every claim in an answer is backed by a real story from the résumé.
approach.zh: 在本地运行、结合简历的面试练习，并检查答案中的每条说法都能在简历的真实经历里找到依据。

l.zh: 第三方源“最近”数据中真正最近的比例（214 / 1,375）

l.zh: 我编写部分的管道测试数

limits.zh: 建立在他人项目之上：看板框架来自上游，我负责岗位数据源、管道与发布。

spec.zh: 独立完成 · MIT 许可

spec.zh: 只用模型配置，不下载权重

spec.en: Live cards for five models
spec.zh: 五个模型的在线卡片

problem.zh: 为一台 GPU 机器选模型，需要在花一小时下载权重之前，先知道它的注意力结构、KV 缓存成本和真实参数量。

deep.title: Bilingual Note Reader

kicker.zh: 个人工具 · 2026 年 10 月

type.en: Local speech synthesis · Obsidian · GPU home server
type.zh: 本地语音合成 · Obsidian · 家用 GPU 服务器

pitch.en: My notes and papers mix Chinese and English. This reads them aloud in Obsidian, switching to a native voice for each language mid-sentence and highlighting the exact sentence being read, on the PDF page itself, all on my own hardware.
pitch.zh: 我的笔记和论文中英混杂。它在 Obsidian 里把它们读出来，句子中途按语言切换成母语声音，并在 PDF 页面上高亮正在读的那一句，全部跑在自己的机器上。

spec.en: Sole author; built on the open-source Narrate plugin, which I patched
spec.zh: 独立完成；基于开源插件 Narrate，并自己打了补丁

spec: Python (standard library) · Docker · Kokoro-82M (CPU) · Qwen3-TTS 1.7B (GPU, PyTorch) · Obsidian plugin (JavaScript, CodeMirror 6)

spec.en: My own notes and PDFs; the demo is Attention Is All You Need, read from the PDF
spec.zh: 我自己的笔记和 PDF；演示读的是 Attention Is All You Need 的 PDF 原文

spec.en: In daily use on a home server, private network only; code private
spec.zh: 在家用服务器上每天使用，只在私有网络内；代码私有

problem.en: Reading a paper like the Transformer paper means long, mixed-language notes. A single-voice reader either mangles the Chinese or mangles the English, cloud speech APIs charge per character and send private notes off the machine, and without a pointer it is easy to lose your place.
problem.zh: 读 Transformer 这类论文，笔记又长又中英混写。只有一个声音的朗读器，不是读坏中文就是读坏英文；云端语音 API 按字收费，还要把私人笔记发出去；没有跟读指示，听着听着就找不到读到哪了。

principle.en: Neural speech models are trained per language, so mixed text has to be split before synthesis, not after.
principle.zh: 神经语音模型按语言训练，所以混合文本要在合成之前切开，而不是之后。

principle.en: Split by script: a run of Han characters is Chinese, Latin letters are English. A Chinese sentence goes to its model whole, never cut at commas, so the intonation stays continuous; English words inside it get the English voice.
principle.zh: 按文字系统切分：连续汉字是中文，拉丁字母是英文。中文句子整句交给模型，不在逗号处切，语调连贯；句中夹的英文词交给英文声音。

principle.en: Pauses are built, not guessed: each clip's own leading and trailing silence is trimmed, then an exact gap is inserted (10 ms at sentence and line ends, 500 ms at an English comma), so timing is deterministic.
principle.zh: 停顿是拼出来的，不靠模型猜：先裁掉每段自带的首尾静音，再插入精确的间隔（句末和换行 10 毫秒，英文逗号 500 毫秒），节奏可预测。

principle.en: Gapless playback: the plugin synthesizes the next three chunks while one plays. Every line synthesizes faster than real time, so after the first line there is no waiting.
principle.zh: 无缝播放：一段在播时，插件预先合成后面三段。每一行的合成都快于实时，所以第一行之后不再等待。

principle.en: A PDF is read from the viewer's own text layer: text items become sentences, and each sentence keeps the exact span of characters it came from, so the highlight lands on the words being spoken, across lines and pages.
principle.zh: PDF 从阅读器自己的文字层读取：文字块被拼成句子，每句都记住它来自哪一段字符，所以高亮正好落在正在读的字上，可以跨行、跨页。

approach.en: A proxy that speaks the OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech API, so the plugin switches engines without a code change; standard-library Python in a 1-CPU, 512 MB container.
approach.zh: 一个兼容 OpenAI /v1/audio/speech 接口的代理，插件不改代码就能换引擎；纯标准库 Python，跑在 1 核 CPU、512 MB 的容器里。

approach.en: Routing: Chinese to Qwen3-TTS 1.7B on the GPU, English to Kokoro-82M on the CPU. If the Chinese model is down, Chinese falls back to Kokoro's Chinese voice.
approach.zh: 分流：中文给 GPU 上的 Qwen3-TTS 1.7B，英文给 CPU 上的 Kokoro-82M。中文模型挂了时，中文自动退回 Kokoro 的中文声音。

approach.en: Chinese clips are normalized to the English voice's loudness, so the switch does not jump in volume.
approach.zh: 中文片段的响度对齐到英文声音，切换时音量不跳。

approach.en: A failed piece is retried once, then replaced by silence, so one bad sentence never stops a long note. Recently read sentences sit in a 120 MB in-memory cache.
approach.zh: 某段合成失败就重试一次，再失败用静音顶上，长笔记不会因为一句出错而中断。最近读过的句子放在 120 MB 的内存缓存里。

approach.en: Plugin patch: one line per chunk, generated navigation blocks skipped, the line being read highlighted and scrolled to the middle of the screen, and reading resumes where it stopped.
approach.zh: 插件补丁：一行一段，跳过自动生成的导航块，正在读的行高亮并滚到屏幕中间，下次从停下的地方继续。

approach.en: PDF mode, modelled on commercial readers: skips running headers, page numbers, footnotes, citations like [12], captions, tables, figure labels and the references; joins words hyphenated across lines; reads a numbered equation as “Equation 1”; Alt+click a sentence to read from there.
approach.zh: PDF 模式，参照商业朗读软件的做法：跳过页眉页脚、页码、脚注、[12] 这类引用、图表标题、表格、图中标签和参考文献；把跨行断开的单词接回去；带编号的公式读作「Equation 1」；按住 Alt 点一句，就从那句开始读。

approach.en: The highlight is drawn under the PDF's text layer and blended like a highlight annotation, so the text stays sharp and the box stays in place when zooming.
approach.zh: 高亮画在 PDF 文字层下面，像高亮批注一样混合，文字保持清晰，缩放时位置不变。

approach.en: Model servers are reachable only inside a Docker network or the private network; no note text is logged.
approach.zh: 模型服务只能在 Docker 内部网络或私有网络里访问；不记录任何笔记文字。

caption.zh: 依据实际运行的部署绘制

切分代理 · 兼容 OpenAI 接口
句子缓存 · 120 MB
Qwen3-TTS 1.7B · GPU · 中文
Kokoro-82M · CPU · 英文

deep.title: Narrated Study Videos

kicker.zh: 个人工具 · 2026 年 10 月

type.en: Script-to-video pipeline · local speech synthesis · Playwright · ffmpeg
type.zh: 脚本生成视频 · 本地语音合成 · Playwright · ffmpeg

pitch.en: I write a system-design or algorithm walkthrough as one sentence per line, and one command turns it into a narrated 1080p video with two voices, Chinese and English subtitles, and code traces taken from actually running the code.
pitch.zh: 我把系统设计或算法讲解写成一行一句的脚本，一条命令就生成 1080p 讲解视频：两个声音、中英字幕，代码执行画面来自真跑代码。

spec.en: Sole author
spec.zh: 独立完成

spec.en: Scripts I write; the demo is a classic interview question, Design a Rate Limiter
spec.zh: 我自己写的脚本；演示是经典面试题「设计限流器」

spec.en: In use for my own study videos; code private
spec.zh: 用来做自己的学习视频；代码私有

problem.en: Explaining a design out loud is the part of an interview you can't practise by reading. Screen-recording myself is slow to redo, one typo means a full retake, and hand-drawn code traces are easy to get subtly wrong.
problem.zh: 把设计讲出来，是面试里光靠读资料练不到的部分。自己录屏改一次就得重来，一个口误就要整段重录；手画的代码执行过程也很容易出细微错误。

principle.en: The script is the source of truth: each line is one spoken sentence, who says it, its Chinese subtitle and the scene shown while it plays. Fix one line and only that line is re-voiced.
principle.zh: 脚本是唯一来源：每行是一句话、谁说、中文字幕，以及这句话播放时的画面。改一行，只重新配这一行。

principle.en: Scenes are data, not drawings. A line names a layout (table, bullets, flow, code trace, array, linked list, tree, split) and its content; the engine renders it as HTML and screenshots it at 1920 × 1080.
principle.zh: 画面是数据，不是画出来的。每行指定一种版式（表格、要点、流程、代码执行、数组、链表、树、左右分栏）和内容；引擎把它渲染成 HTML，再按 1920 × 1080 截图。

principle.en: Code traces are generated by running the algorithm: the build script executes the code, records each step (line, variables, verdict) and asserts the expected result, so the picture cannot drift from what the code does.
principle.zh: 代码执行画面由真跑算法生成：构建脚本执行代码，记下每一步（行号、变量、结果），并断言预期输出，画面不可能和代码实际行为不一致。

principle.en: Each sentence becomes its own clip, sized to its audio plus a pause (0.9 s on a scene change, 0.6 s on a speaker change, 0.35 s otherwise); clips are concatenated and normalised to -16 LUFS, a common loudness target for online video.
principle.zh: 每句话单独成段，时长 = 音频 + 停顿（换画面 0.9 秒、换人 0.6 秒、其他 0.35 秒）；拼接后响度统一到 -16 LUFS，这是在线视频常用的响度标准。

approach.en: One engine, six commands: check (missing audio or subtitles), tts (resumable), preview (one frame per distinct scene), render (one chapter or the whole video), install, plus a translation to-do list.
approach.zh: 一个引擎、六条命令：check（查缺音频或字幕）、tts（可续跑）、preview（每种画面出一帧）、render（单章或全片）、install，以及待翻译清单。

approach.en: Two voices on a local Kokoro server behind an OpenAI-compatible speech API: one for the candidate, one for the interviewer; interviewer subtitles sit on a different colour band.
approach.zh: 两个声音，跑在本地 Kokoro 服务上（兼容 OpenAI 语音接口）：候选人一个、面试官一个；面试官的字幕底条换颜色。

approach.en: Eleven built-in layouts; a topic can add its own scenes in a small Python hook without touching the engine.
approach.zh: 内置 11 种版式；专题可以在一个小的 Python 钩子里加自己的画面，不用改引擎。

approach.en: Preview before render: every distinct scene is screenshotted first, so overflowing labels and wrong states are caught in seconds, not after a full render. On the demo this caught a double-escaped < and a design diagram that wrongly put Redis on the request path.
approach.zh: 先预览再渲染：每种画面先截一张图，文字溢出、状态错误几秒内就能发现，不用等全片渲染完。在演示视频里，这一步抓到了一个被转义两次的 <，以及一张把 Redis 错画在请求路径上的架构图。

approach.en: Interview structure for system design: prompt, clarifying questions with what each answer locks in, functional and non-functional requirements, an estimate, the algorithm trade-off, the design, a deep dive with interviewer follow-ups, then a recap.
approach.zh: 系统设计按面试结构走：出题 → 澄清（每个答案锁定什么）→ 功能和非功能需求 → 估算 → 算法取舍 → 架构 → 深挖（面试官追问）→ 总结。

approach.en: Free and local: no paid API, no upload; the encoder comes from a pip package, so nothing is installed system-wide.
approach.zh: 免费、本地：不调付费 API、不上传；编码器来自 pip 包，不往系统里装东西。

kicker.zh: 独立原型 · 2026 年 10 月

type.zh: 银行卡争议 · Go · 合成数据

pitch.en: Card networks redeliver and regulators set deadlines; this service turns both into one record per case, a dated deadline and a person in the loop for anything risky.
pitch.zh: 卡组织会重复投递，监管会设截止时间；这个服务把两者变成：每个案件一条记录、明确的截止日期，有风险的都交给人。

spec.en: Sole author; an independent prototype, not employer work
spec.zh: 独立完成；个人原型，非雇主项目

spec: Go (standard library) · REST · Prometheus · go test -race

spec.en: Synthetic Visa/Mastercard-style CSV and issuer-webhook disputes
spec.zh: 合成的 Visa/Mastercard 风格 CSV 与发卡行 webhook 争议数据

spec.en: Open source; runs locally, not deployed
spec.zh: 开源；本地运行，未部署

problem.en: Disputes arrive as network CSV batches and issuer webhooks, often more than once. Each one starts a Regulation E or Z clock, and an automatic credit on a fraudulent claim is money that does not come back.
problem.zh: 争议以卡组织 CSV 批次和发卡行 webhook 的形式到达，而且经常重复。每一条都会启动 Reg E 或 Reg Z 的计时，对欺诈申请自动入账，钱就回不来了。

approach.en: Normalizes Visa and Mastercard reason codes and issuer categories into one model; amounts parse to integer cents, and every field error in a row is kept in a quarantine log.
approach.zh: 把 Visa、Mastercard 原因码和发卡行类别统一成一个模型；金额解析为整数分；一行里的每个字段错误都写入隔离日志。

approach.en: Idempotent ingestion keyed on network + case ID: a redelivery returns 200, the same ID with different content returns 409.
approach.zh: 以「卡组织 + 案件号」做幂等：重复投递返回 200，同一编号内容不同返回 409。

approach.en: Simplified Reg E (debit) and Reg Z (credit) deadlines, plus a flag for filings outside the 120-day network window.
approach.zh: 简化版 Reg E（借记卡）和 Reg Z（信用卡）截止日期，并标记超出 120 天卡组织窗口的申请。

approach.en: Auto-credits only low-risk, in-window cases under a limit; named fraud signals send a case to manual review. There is no auto-deny.
approach.zh: 只有低风险、在窗口内、低于限额的案件自动临时入账；命中具名欺诈信号就转人工审核；不做自动拒绝。

approach.en: Parallel validation, serialized commits, and a hash-chained ledger that is verified on startup and refuses to start if edited.
approach.zh: 并行校验、串行提交；哈希链账本启动时校验，被改过就拒绝启动。

limits.zh: 只用合成数据；没有接入任何卡组织或银行。

limits.en: Regulatory rules are simplified: no bank holidays, new-account extensions or per-reason-code network windows.
limits.zh: 监管规则是简化版：没有银行假日、新账户延期，也没有按原因码区分的卡组织窗口。

limits.en: The ledger is a local file; a production version would keep the chain in PostgreSQL behind a unique constraint.
limits.zh: 账本是本地文件；生产版本会把哈希链放进 PostgreSQL，并加唯一约束。

kicker.zh: 独立重建 · 私有仓库

type.zh: 隐私与策略平台 · 2026 年 9 月

pitch.en: Detect personal data in what employees send to AI tools, decide allow / mask / watch / block, and keep an audit trail no one can quietly edit.
pitch.zh: 检测员工发往 AI 工具内容中的个人数据，决定放行 / 脱敏 / 观察 / 拦截，并保留无法被悄悄修改的审计记录。

spec.en: Sole engineer, 100% of commits. A clean-room rebuild of the kind of system I worked on at Polygraf.ai
spec.zh: 独立完成，100% 提交。对我在 Polygraf.ai 参与过的同类系统做的净室重建

spec: Python · FastAPI · PostgreSQL/pgvector · Redis · React · Docker · OpenTofu (AWS design)

spec.en: Code private; the detector guards the live Career OPS release
spec.zh: 代码私有；检测器守护在线 Career OPS 的发布

problem.en: AI-usage governance needs three things to hold at once: detection that works in English and Chinese, policy decisions that are deterministic, and an audit history that survives worker crashes and retries.
problem.zh: AI 使用治理需要同时成立三件事：中英文都可用的检测、确定性的策略判定、以及在 worker 崩溃和重试后依然正确的审计历史。

approach.en: Policy engine as one pure function over the event and policy set, so every decision is reproducible.
approach.zh: 策略引擎是对事件与策略集的一个纯函数，每次判定都可复现。

approach.en: Separate governance and PII-detection APIs with role-based access; audit records keep categories, hashes and offsets, never the raw input text.
approach.zh: 治理 API 与 PII 检测 API 分开部署，按角色控制访问；审计记录只保留类别、哈希和位置，从不保存原始输入文本。

approach.en: Ingestion through a Postgres transactional outbox; workers claim events with SKIP LOCKED and record findings and incidents in a hash-chained history.
approach.zh: 通过 Postgres 事务性 outbox 接入；worker 用 SKIP LOCKED 领取事件，把发现与事件写入哈希链历史。

approach.en: Found and fixed a lease-expiry race: a stalled worker could finish an event another worker had already processed. It now locks the row and proceeds only while the status is still processing.
approach.zh: 发现并修复租约过期竞态：卡住的 worker 可能重复处理别人已完成的事件。现在会锁行，且仅在状态仍为 processing 时继续。

deep.title: Remote Commander Ops

kicker.zh: 运维工具集 · 私有仓库

type.zh: macOS 进程监督与监控 · 2026 年 10 月

pitch.en: Keeps a home Mac reachable from a phone through an AI chat client: launchd supervision, a safe installer, and a metadata-only monitor that says why remote access is down.
pitch.zh: 让家里的 Mac 能通过手机上的 AI 聊天客户端随时被调用：launchd 监督、安全的安装器，以及只记元数据、能说清为什么断线的监控。

spec.en: Sole engineer. Wraps the MIT-licensed Desktop Commander remote device without forking it
spec.zh: 独立完成。包装 MIT 许可的 Desktop Commander 远程设备，不做分叉

spec: zsh · launchd · Python 3.9 stdlib · BSD awk · GitHub Actions (macOS)

spec.en: Process and socket metadata only; no command lines, file contents or tokens are ever stored
spec.zh: 只用进程和套接字元数据；从不存储命令行、文件内容或令牌

spec.en: Deployed on the author's Mac on 2026-10-10; 14-day availability observation in progress
spec.zh: 2026-10-10 部署在作者的 Mac 上；14 天可用性观察进行中

problem.en: The vendor's remote device is a long-running process that holds a rotating OAuth session. Started by hand it dies with the terminal; started twice it rotates the same refresh token and breaks the connection; supervised naively it restarts every 30 seconds forever after a logout. And a running process does not mean the relay connection is alive.
problem.zh: 厂商的远程设备是一个持有轮换 OAuth 会话的常驻进程。手动启动会随终端一起退出；启动两份会互相轮换同一个刷新令牌、弄断连接；简单交给监督器又会在登出后每 30 秒无限重启。而且进程活着并不代表中继连接还在。

approach.en: A pinned runtime under launchd. The launcher refuses to start a second supervised instance and waits while a terminal-launched one exists; matching the vendor process by its full command line fixed a real bug where a full-path node or a path with spaces slipped past.
approach.zh: 锁定版本的运行时交给 launchd。启动脚本拒绝启动第二个托管实例，并在终端手动实例存在时等待；按完整命令行匹配厂商进程修复了一个真实 bug：完整路径的 node 或带空格的路径曾被漏判。

approach.en: An installer with --check (read-only diff), idempotent --prepare and --activate --yes that backs up, swaps and restores itself when launchd rejects the new job. Every path is tested against stubbed launchctl, ps and plutil.
approach.zh: 安装器提供只读对比的 --check、幂等的 --prepare，以及会先备份、再替换、launchd 拒绝时自动回滚的 --activate --yes。每条路径都用替身的 launchctl、ps、plutil 测试。

approach.en: A one-minute monitor classifies each tick as ok / process / auth / relay / network / unknown: it counts the supervised pid's established connections to the relay port, probes the network only when that connection is gone, and reads the session file's age against the vendor's 45-minute refresh. Three consecutive failures raise one alert; recovery raises one more. Notification ships off.
approach.zh: 每分钟一次的监控把每个时刻分为 ok / process / auth / relay / network / unknown：统计托管进程到中继端口的已建立连接，只在连接消失时探测网络，并按厂商 45 分钟的刷新节奏判断会话文件是否过期。连续三次失败只发一次告警，恢复再发一次；通知默认关闭。

approach.en: The same process matcher exists in awk (launcher) and Python (monitor); a parity test runs both over one fixture corpus and caught the one case where they disagreed.

learned.en: A weekend demo proves the idea and hides the edge cases. What the demo does not handle is where the real work starts.
learned.zh: 周末做出的演示能证明想法，也会藏住边界情况。演示处理不了的地方，才是真正工作的开始。

rule.en: Write down what it does not handle, next to what it does.
rule.zh: 把它处理不了的写清楚，放在它能做的旁边。

then.en: Followed Radu Mariescu-Istodor's self-driving car course (sensors and a neural network in plain JavaScript), ran object-detection experiments on top of the ImageAI library, and explored the OTTO session-based recommender challenge.
then.zh: 跟着 Radu Mariescu-Istodor 的自动驾驶课程用纯 JavaScript 实现传感器和神经网络；在 ImageAI 库上做目标检测实验；研究 OTTO 基于会话的推荐赛题。

learned.en: Writing a network by hand made shapes, weights and memory concrete, which is what I check first when picking a model today. Tutorials are for learning; they are credited, not presented as my work.
learned.zh: 手写一个网络让形状、权重和内存变得具体，这正是我今天选模型时首先检查的东西。教程用来学习，要注明出处，不当成自己的作品。

rule.en: Know a model's shapes and memory cost before downloading it.
rule.zh: 下载模型之前，先弄清它的形状和内存成本。

archive.stack: Python · Django · JavaScript · shell deploy script

then.en: A Django web app with a dashboard and landing pages for AI chat workflows, built with contract developers and deployed to a server by script.
then.zh: 一个面向 AI 助手流程的 Django 网站，含后台和落地页，与外包开发者合作完成，用脚本部署到服务器。

learned.en: With several people pushing to one server, the deploy script was the only process. Nothing stopped a broken change, and nobody could say what was live.
learned.zh: 几个人往同一台服务器推代码时，部署脚本就是唯一的流程。没有东西能拦住坏改动，也没人说得清线上是什么版本。

rule.en: Tests and a release gate before production; every deploy traceable to a commit.
rule.zh: 上生产之前要有测试和发布闸门；每次部署都能追溯到提交。

then.en: An AI companion chat app and a messaging app, built in days with Replit's coding agent.
then.zh: 用 Replit 的编程 Agent 几天内做出的 AI 陪伴聊天应用和消息应用。

learned.en: Generated code arrives fast and without tests, so no one can change it safely a week later. The speed is real; the missing tests are the cost.
learned.zh: 生成的代码来得快，但没有测试，一周后谁也不敢改。速度是真的，缺失的测试就是代价。

rule.en: Write the failing test first, even when an agent writes the code.
rule.zh: 即使代码由 Agent 来写，也先写失败的测试。

decisions_intro.en: Three calls I made on real projects, in the same shape as the learning archive: what happened, what it taught me and what it cost, the rule I kept, and where it shows today.
decisions_intro.zh: 我在真实项目里做的三个决定，格式和学习档案一样：当时发生了什么，学到什么、代价是什么，留下的规则，今天体现在哪里。

title.en: The model can suggest; code decides what is booked
title.zh: 模型可以建议，订什么由代码决定

then.en: We let a language model fill bilingual restaurant bookings. In a 30-case pilot only 17 were fully correct, and 3 contained details the guest never gave.
then.zh: 我们让语言模型填写中英双语的餐厅预订。30 例试点里只有 17 例完全正确，3 例填了客人根本没说过的信息。

learned.en: A better prompt could not be the only guard on a booking a real guest relies on. I moved every booking field and the final confirmation into code and kept the model for language. The cost: one more confirmation step for the guest.
learned.zh: 真实客人要依赖的预订，不能只靠更好的提示词把关。我把每个预订字段和最后的确认都改由代码处理，模型只负责语言。代价：客人要多确认一步。

rule.en: Anything committed on a customer's behalf is validated by code and confirmed with an explicit yes.
rule.zh: 凡是替客户提交的东西，都由代码校验，并且要客人明确说「是」。

result.en: On a separate 39-case held-out set: 33 fully correct, 0 invented values. The two sets are not a like-for-like before and after.
result.zh: 在另一份 39 例留出集上：33 例完全正确，0 个编造值。两套数据不是严格可比的前后对照。

status.en: Career OPS · personal project · Sep 30 snapshot
status.zh: Career OPS · 个人项目 · 9 月 30 日快照

title.en: A traceable record beats a bigger dataset
title.zh: 可追溯的记录，胜过更大的数据量

then.en: A third-party job feed showed the date a posting was found as the date it was published, so stale jobs looked new. Of its 1,375 “recent” rows, only 214 were actually recent.
then.zh: 第三方岗位数据把「抓到的日期」当成「发布日期」，旧岗位看起来像新的。它标为「最近」的 1,375 条里，真正是最近的只有 214 条。

learned.en: More rows were worth less than rows I could trace. I switched to employers' own ATS APIs and kept the source link and timestamp on every record. The cost: every ATS has its own schema and its own meaning of “posted”, so each source needs its own mapping.
learned.zh: 条数多，不如每条都能追溯。我改用雇主自己的 ATS 接口，每条记录都保留来源链接和时间戳。代价：每个 ATS 的格式和「发布」的含义都不同，每个来源都要单独做映射。

rule.en: Know where a field came from before you trust it.
rule.zh: 先知道一个字段从哪来，再决定信不信它。

result.en: 264,148 postings from native sources in the Sep 30, 2026 snapshot, each with its source link.
result.zh: 2026 年 9 月 30 日快照：264,148 个岗位，全部来自原始来源，每条都带来源链接。

status.en: BloomFrontier · Jackson Ventures · merged Oct 2026, not deployed
status.zh: BloomFrontier · Jackson Ventures · 2026 年 10 月已合并，未部署

title.zh: 模型永远不能自己动钱

then.en: Loan officers review construction-draw evidence before money is released. Automated checks could flag missing documents; the question was how far to let them go.
then.zh: 放款前，信贷员要审核工程提款的证据。自动检查能标出缺失的文件，问题是让它走多远。

learned.en: Checks may raise a flag, but release needs a person and the database. I separated evidence checks, two-person approval and database-enforced limits, and split the work into small pull requests that could each be reviewed on their own. The cost: more review time and a more complex workflow, in exchange for clear accountability.
learned.zh: 检查可以报警，但放款要靠人和数据库。我把证据检查、双人审批和数据库强制的限制分开，并把工作拆成能各自单独审核的小 PR。代价：审核时间更长、流程更复杂，换来的是清楚的责任归属。

rule.en: Anything that moves money needs a person's sign-off and a database constraint, not a model's answer.
rule.zh: 凡是动钱的操作，要有人签字、有数据库约束，而不是靠模型的回答。

result.en: 5 pull requests merged on Oct 9, 2026, with 103 financial tests on real PostgreSQL, including concurrent approvals. Not yet deployed.
result.zh: 5 个 PR 于 2026 年 10 月 9 日合并，103 个资金相关测试跑在真实 PostgreSQL 上，包括并发审批。尚未部署。
